items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Ahmad and him had the same agent, Jack (Whittemore) he did both of them, Ahmad introduced them to him... [INTERVIEWEE] I knew Ahmad a long time.

ctx.x: (laughs) In Chicago. And he said, “Yeah you know, I made some mistakes.” He wanted to invest.
Yeah, he was young. But Ahmad and him had the same agent, Jack (Whittemore) he did both of them, Ahmad introduced them to him, he was excellent, very individual.
I knew Ahmad a long time.
